item.title: 2026 Victorian state election: Premier and Labor leader Ben Carroll concedes defeat to Liberal leader Jess Wilson, with preliminary results suggesting a significant decline in the Labor vote. / Residents of the Australian state of Victoria vote to elect 88 seats of the Legislative Assembly and 40 seats of the Legislative Council.
item.description:
Image: ABC News Australia

Premier and Labor leader Ben Carroll concedes defeat to Liberal leader Jess Wilson, with preliminary results suggesting a significant decline in the Labor vote. Wilson is set to become the first millennial to lead Victoria, and the first woman to do so by winning a general election.

Sources: ABC News Australia

Residents of the Australian state of Victoria vote to elect 88 seats of the Legislative Assembly and 40 seats of the Legislative Council. Incumbent premier Ben Carroll seeks to win a fourth consecutive Labor government over the Liberal–National Coalition, led by opposition leader Jess Wilson.

Sources: ABC News Australia, The Guardian

Topics: 2026 Victorian state election
